pages.text: Earn these from bosses — nothing else drops them. Simply Swords uniques are the best weapons in the pack: not craftable, not tradeable, never in chests, each matched thematically to its boss.$(br2)$(bold){{uniques kind=sword count}} swords and {{uniques kind=bow count}} bows$() across all four tiers. A boss drops its unique on {{uniques dropped=yes minchance}} to {{uniques dropped=yes maxchance}} of kills.

pages.title: Building Around One
pages.text: $(bold)Build note:$() Uniques have no enchanting penalty — Apotheosis enchanting and affix reforging both work. A unique with excellent affixes and level 5 enchants is the strongest item in the pack.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pick a target from $(l:icraft:bosses/t2_bosses)Tier 2 Bosses$(/l) and go earn one.$()
